messages:
lin: hey team, im Lin (started today on infra). quick q: who do i ping for deploy approvals vs emergency rollbacks for runtime/config changes?
ashley: welcome Lin! :tada: Deploy approvals are owned by eng-platform (check infra/OWNERS). Emergency rollbacks -> #eng-oncall AND tag @jordan. For non-urgent config tweaks, add the `deploy-ready` label on the PR.
jordan: +1. Oncall will triage rollbacks; platform handles approval gate. If the change affects latency or throughput, loop in @cora (SRE lead) early.
lin: cool. wheres the canonical owners list?
ashley: two places: 1) repo: `infra/OWNERS` and 2) Confluence -> Team Directory -> Ownership Matrix. Quick local search: `rg "owners" infra/OWNERS` or `git grep -n "runtime-config"`.
jordan: also see the Runtime Change Playbook on Confluence for who-to-cc by change tier. runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.example/runbooks/runtime-change-playbook
lin: any SLAs for approvals/reviews?
cora: small low-risk changes: target 24h review. Prod-impacting or perf regressions: target 4h during 9-5 PST. For anything blocking traffic, follow the incident workflow and ping the phone rota (PagerDuty link: https://pd.redwood.example/rotations).
lin: if i suspect a security problem in a config, who should i contact immediately?
ashley: sec@redwood.com and add `sec-review` label on the PR. Also notify sec-oncall and your manager.
infrabot: @lin has been added to infra/OWNERS (team: runtime-config)  welcome aboard! :sparkles:
lin: perfect, thanks all. ill skim the runbook and open a PR later today and tag the right people. appreciate the quick orientation!
